label: Synthesized historical materialism with feminist critique of peripheral capitalism
description: In Women in Class Society (1969), Saffioti showed that Brazilian capitalism relies structurally on women’s unpaid and marginalized labor within a patriarchal-racial knot.
dialecticalTension: Pioneers Latin American Marxist-feminist social theory.

label: Anchored Beauvoir’s critique of gender subordination in Brazilian class sociology
description: Saffioti combined Beauvoir’s insight into women’s social construction with empirical Marxist sociology of Brazilian labor.
dialecticalTension: Bridges existential gender critique and Latin American structural sociology.
historicalContext: A Mulher na Sociedade de Classes (1969).

citations.author: Heleieth Saffioti
citations.work: A Mulher na Sociedade de Classes

label: Provided structural Brazilian sociology of gender-race-class alongside Gonzalez
description: Saffioti’s early formulation of the patriarchy-racism-capitalism knot intersected directly with Lélia Gonzalez’s Black feminist sociology in 1970s–80s Brazil.
dialecticalTension: Cross-fertilizes Brazilian Marxist feminism and Afro-Brazilian Amefricanidade.
